risks.description: PII found without evidence of anonymization

recommendations.title: Anonymize or pseudonymize PII
recommendations.description: Found 2659 PII instances of types: postal_code, credit_card, name
recommendations.action: Use anonymization_agent to remove or pseudonymize PII before publication

recommendations.title: Implement additional safeguards for high-risk data
recommendations.action: Implement encryption, access control, and logging for high-risk data

recommendations.title: Conduct formal Data Protection Impact Assessment
recommendations.description: Formal DPIA required due to PII processing and high-risk data
recommendations.action: Complete the DPIA report and submit to data protection officer

recommendations.title: Update privacy documentation
recommendations.description: Privacy notice and data processing records need updating
recommendations.action: Update README and documentation with privacy information
